questions.question: Q1 What is the primary purpose of deposition in semiconductor manufacturing?

answers.a: To remove material from the wafer
answers.b: To add thin layers of material onto the wafer

explanations.a: Material removal is performed during etching.
explanations.b: Correct! Deposition adds thin films onto the wafer surface.
explanations.d: Crystal growth occurs during wafer manufacturing.

questions.question: Q2 Which of the following is commonly deposited on semiconductor wafers?

explanations.a: Correct! Silicon dioxide is one of the most common deposited materials.
explanations.b: Wood is not used in semiconductor fabrication.
explanations.c: Plastic sheets are not deposited onto wafers.
explanations.d: Rubber is not used as a semiconductor thin film.

questions.question: Q3 Which process adds material to the wafer surface?
Q4 What does CVD stand for?

explanations.a: Correct! CVD stands for Chemical Vapor Deposition.
explanations.b: This is not a semiconductor process.

questions.question: Q5 In Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), material reaches the wafer primarily in the form of:

explanations.a: Solids are not directly used in CVD.
explanations.c: Correct! Reactive gases form the deposited layer.

questions.question: Q6 What does PVD stand for?

explanations.a: Correct! PVD stands for Physical Vapor Deposition.

questions.question: Q7 Which parameter directly affects deposited layer thickness?

explanations.a: Correct! Longer deposition time increases thickness.
explanations.c: Lighting does not affect deposition thickness.

questions.question: Q8 Which material is often used as an insulating layer in semiconductor devices?

explanations.a: Copper is mainly used for interconnections.
explanations.b: Correct! Silicon dioxide acts as an insulator.
explanations.c: Gold is used in packaging and bonding.

questions.question: Q9 What is a thin film?

answers.a: A very thin layer of deposited material

explanations.a: Correct! Thin films are extremely thin deposited layers.
explanations.d: An ingot is formed before wafer fabrication.

questions.question: Q10 Why are multiple deposited layers used in integrated circuits?

answers.b: To create different functional device layers

explanations.b: Correct! Multiple layers form transistors, insulators, and interconnects.
explanations.c: Layer deposition does not reduce wafer diameter.
